description: This is a Java class implementing the UserService interface, responsible for user creation, retrieval, and deletion within a billing software system. It interacts with the UserRepository and handles user entity conversions, role retrieval, and user list generation.

classes.name: UserServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of UserService interface, handling user-related business logic in the billing system.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user from a UserRequest, persists it in the repository, and returns a UserResponse.

methods.name: convertToResponse
methods.description: Converts a UserEntity object to a UserResponse DTO.

methods.name: convertToEntity
methods.description: Converts a UserRequest DTO to a UserEntity, encoding the password and assigning a UUID.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves the role of an existing user based on email.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Fetches all users from the repository and returns a list of UserResponse objects.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a user identified by user ID after fetching from the repository.
